preferredRetailersNote: Retailer names (as in the library) to list first in bottle tables, e.g. authorized luxury retailers.
insiderLinkNote: Set insiderLink once the paid tier exists; empty hides the footer Insider line.
beehiivFormIdNote: data-beehiiv-form value from the published beehiiv form "Site signup: Price Book". Empty = signups off (forms say so and hand over the PDF).
waitlistFormIdNote: beehiiv form "Site: Price alerts waitlist". Empty = scent/guide pages show the old free price-watch box instead of the waitlist.
homeHeadMetaNote: Bing and Pinterest site verification tags, home page head only.
headMetaNote: Raw tags added to every page head (site verification for affiliate networks). Keep the Impact tag: removing it can break Impact verification.

cj._note: CJ Affiliate. Links to an enabled advertiser's domain become https://www.anrdoezrs.net/links/<pid>/type/dlg/<product url>. To switch on FragranceX or Jomashop once CJ approves them: fill id, set enabled true (and add an offers block to partners/cj-offers.json if they should get an 'Also in stock' line).

amazon._note: Amazon Associates (approved 2026-11-17). Every scent page gets an 'Also on Amazon' line: a /dp/ASIN link when partners/amazon-asins.json has the scent's slug, otherwise an Amazon search link. The tag is added by affiliate.rules (Amazon).

rakuten._note: Rakuten Advertising. Links to an enabled advertiser's domain become https://click.linksynergy.com/link?id=<id>&offerid=<offerid>&type=2&murl=<url-encoded product url> (or /deeplink?id=&mid=&murl= when only mid is set). id = the publisher's encrypted ID (id= in any Rakuten link); offerid = offerid= in that advertiser's text link. An advertiser with an offersFile adds its in-stock sample sizes to every matching scent once enabled. MicroPerfumes approved and switched on 2026-11-18.

giftFormIdNote: beehiiv form "Site: Gift guide 2026" (redirects to /gift-guide/thanks/). Empty = the gift guide shows a direct PDF download instead of the signup form.

answerFirst.note: Test (2026-11-18): these scent pages open with a one-sentence price answer and use it as the meta description, so AI answers and search snippets can lift it. Compare their search/AI traffic against the rest before rolling out to all pages.

analyticsSnippetNote: Vercel Web Analytics. The inline part tags the landing page view of a visit that came from an AI assistant (referrer or utm_source) or any other utm_source as /from/<source>/<page>, because the UTM dimension and custom events need a paid Vercel plan. Count with startswith(requestPath,'/from/').

searchPlan._note: Search plan 2026-11-27 (docs/seo/search-plan-2026-11.md). upgradeSlugs: verdict-first title and 'Safe blind buy?' answer up top. keepIndexed: scent pages kept indexed even if thin (Google landings). noindexThin: thin scent pages (no in-stock USD price with notes or verdict, no guide) get noindex,follow and leave the sitemap. fairPremium: the sample button goes to a paying program (Rakuten/CJ) when its sample costs at most max(usd, pct% of) more than the cheapest and its price per ml is at most ppmPct% higher.
